title: Village Nuclei Isolation With Myelin Removal
author: Steve McCarroll
materials: Gather Supplies Razor Blades Glass slides Syringes with needles (3 mL syringe with 26 1⁄2 gauge needle) Myelin removal beads (cat # 130-096-731) https://www.miltenyibiotec.com/US-en/products/myelin-removal-beads-ii-human-mouse-rat.html#gref Eppendorf tubes (1.5 mL and 5 mL) Eppendorf or Rainin pipette tips Dry ice 20 µM filter 6 well tissue culture plate Magnetic Bead Separation Rack for 1.5 mL tubes RNAse free water PBS BSA Lucigen RNAse inhibitor (i)

Solutions to make fresh before starting experiment DB + 5% Kollidon 64 + 0.2 U/uL Lucigen RNAse Inhibitor (5 uL/mL) Filtering and spinning down buffer: DB + 0.016 U/uL Lucigen RNAse inhibitor (5-12.5 uL/12.5 mLs) (In earlier experiments 12.5 uL of inhibitor were used, but this was later scaled down to 5 uL) 10X cell loading buffer: 1% BSA + 0.2 U/uL of i
Count a dilution of the nuclei.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and materials to maintain cold temperatures throughout the process.

substeps.instruction: Turn on and chill 1.5 mL and 50 mL centrifuges with swinging buckets to 4°C
Prepare all required reagents on ice
Clean glass slides with ethanol
Pre-chill glass slides, razors, and syringes with needles

steps.title: Section and Mince Tissue
steps.instruction: Mince the tissue using a pre-chilled razor and glass slide, either in a cryostat or on ice, avoiding white matter as much as possible.

steps.title: Initial Tissue Extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer minced tissue into a well of a 6-well plate with extraction buffer and mix.

substeps.instruction: For small extractions (~600 mg tissue), use 1-2 mLs of extraction buffer
For larger extractions (~1000 mg tissue), use 3+ mLs of extraction buffer
Mix approximately 20 times using a 1000µL pipette

steps.title: Incubate and Homogenize
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample on ice for 10 minutes, mixing approximately 20 times with the pipette every 2 minutes.

steps.title: Syringe the Sample
steps.instruction: Pass the sample through a syringe based on the extraction size.

substeps.instruction: Small extraction (1-2 mLs): Syringe into the same well of the 6-well tissue culture plate
Larger extraction (3+ mLs): Transfer the syringed tissue+buffer into a new well of a 6-well tissue culture plate each time the sample is passed through a syringe

steps.title: Filter and Flush Nuclei
steps.instruction: Filter the sample through a 20 uM filter and flush with DB + i.

substeps.instruction: Flush the filter with 12.5 mLs of DB + i for every 1 mL of extraction buffer used

steps.title: Aliquot and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Divide the volume into 50 mL tubes and spin down to pellet nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Split volume into multiple 50 mL tubes so each tube contains 12.5 mL of sample
Spin down for 10 minutes at 4°C at 500 x g (human/primate tissue) or 600 x g (mouse)

steps.title: Resuspend Nuclei
steps.instruction: Remove supernatants and resuspend the pellets in DB + i.

substeps.instruction: Discard supernatants
Combine and resuspend pellets in DB + i (use 10 mLs DB + i for a large ~1000 mg extraction)

steps.title: Prepare for Myelin Removal
steps.instruction: Dilute the nuclei and add myelin removal beads.

substeps.instruction: Dilute nuclei to 1000 n/µL using 10X cell loading buffer (1% BSA in PBS + 0.2U/uL i)
Add myelin removal beads at a concentration of 10 uL of beads per mL of nuclei (at 1000 N/uL)

steps.title: Incubate with Beads
steps.instruction: Mix the nuclei with beads and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Mix and aliquot nuclei into 1.5 mL tubes
Incubate nuclei with rotation at 4°C for 15 minutes

steps.title: Magnetic Separation of Myelin
steps.instruction: Use a magnet to separate the myelin beads from the nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Briefly spin down tubes to remove liquid from caps
Place tubes on a magnet at 4°C for 30 minutes
Transfer nuclei to new tubes, pulling up from the bottom to avoid the myelin pellet on the side of the tube

steps.title: Final Wash and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Perform a final spin and resuspend the nuclei in loading buffer.

substeps.instruction: Spin down nuclei at 400 x g at 4°C for 5 minutes
Remove and discard the supernatant
Resuspend the pellet in 10X cell loading buffer (1% BSA + 0.2 U/uL i)
